name: Filter intake tube
label: Filters
lead: Intake tube with strainer for external filters - a clear replacement part with suction cups that protects fish and filter.

description.html: The filter intake tube is a replacement part through which an external filter draws water from the aquarium. The clear tube is bent at the top to go over the aquarium rim and is held against the glass by two suction-cup clips. At the lower end, a strainer keeps fish, shrimp, leaves and larger debris out of the filter.

Replace the intake tube when the old one is damaged, cracked or lost, or when you want a clear tube instead of the original. The photo is illustrative, and connection diameters vary from filter to filter, so call us to check whether it fits your model.

Clean the strainer regularly, every time you clean the filter, because a clogged strainer reduces flow and strains the pump. Clean the inside of the tube with a hose brush from time to time so algae and sediment do not build up. In a tank with fry or shrimp, you can fit a sponge over the strainer.
